native.i2c_profile: Actual electrical qualification. Section7.2 higher load requires its own proven timing/drive/segmentation and frequency bound.
native.i2c_mode: Operating mode. STANDARD100kbit/s is a proposed baseline, not minimum clock frequency. UFm is a different unidirectional push-pull system.
native.i2c_endpoint_role: Actual endpoint role. A pure controller needs no own target address; controller-target does.
native.i2c_controller_id: Actual canonical clock-owning controller identity. No invented ECU identity or topology owner confirmation.
native.i2c_device_source: Actual controller/target datasheet revision, supported modes, pins and address constraints.
native.i2c_binding_source: Actual matching controller-target port and segment binding, with unique addresses/multiplexing evidence.
native.i2c_physical_source: Actual voltage/pull-up/driver/load/edge/threshold/segment evidence; nominal rate is not electrical validation.
native.i2c_schedule_source: Actual transactions, register/address phases, polling/retry/stretch/arbitration and functional acceptance evidence.
native.i2c_drive: Actual driver. Sm/Fm/Fm+ wired-AND open drain/collector; HS controller current source; UFm push-pull.
native.i2c_address_bits: Actual7/10-bit target address width, no inferred7-bit hardware configuration.
native.i2c_target_address: Actual unshifted target address, excluding R/W. Reserved7-bit purposes require explicit matching service evidence.
native.i2c_address_purpose: Actual ordinary versus reserved service addressing; general call/START/HS code/prefix are not interchangeable targets.
native.i2c_address_source: Actual device straps/register/assigned address and reserved service meaning; unknown, no automatic0x20.
native.i2c_direction: Actual transaction direction. UFm accepts writes only; bidirectional requires combined address phases.
native.i2c_multi_controller: Actual competing controller configuration. Arbitration is unnecessary for a proven single controller, not assumed false.
native.i2c_clock_stretch_supported: Actual matched controller/target stretching support. UFm cannot stretch; HS stretches only after ACK.
native.i2c_hs_entry_rate_bps: Actual F/S-mode HS controller-code entry clock. HS3.4M data rate cannot size this preceding phase.
native.i2c_hs_controller_code: Actual reserved8-bit HS controller code00001XXX; code8 reserved test/diagnostic, not a target address.
native.i2c_hs_diagnostic: Actual test/diagnostic use permitting controller code8; no implicit operational use.
native.i2c_stretch_position: Actual stretch placement: HS only after ACK, UFm none. Stretch upper bound is device/schedule data, not a spec default.
native.i2c_ack_policy: Bidirectional ACK/NACK is not CRC or functional acceptance. UFm preserves ninth pulse HIGH without target acknowledgement.
native.i2c_vdd_v: Actual pull-up/driver supply domain; no universal3.3/5V.
native.i2c_vil_max_v: Actual receiver LOW threshold, including legacy fixed-level parts and level translators.
native.i2c_vih_min_v: Actual receiver HIGH threshold, not universally inferred from current CMOS ratios.
native.i2c_vol_max_v: Actual worst-case driver LOW at actual current/voltage/temperature.
native.i2c_voh_min_v: Actual UFm push-pull HIGH guarantee; passive open drain HIGH is pull-up/leakage/load evidence.
native.i2c_sink_bound_ma: Actual safe sink capability at specified VOL, not automatically3mA/20mA.
native.i2c_source_bound_ma: Actual UFm source capability or HS current-source qualification; not passive pull-up current.
native.i2c_pullup_ohms: Actual passive pull-up for Sm/Fm/Fm+; Rp minimum depends on sink and VOL, maximum on rise time and capacitance. No4.7k default.
native.i2c_bus_cap_pf: Actual per-line wire+pins+connectors capacitance. Table11 limits400/400/550pF, HS100..400 interpolated timing; UFm no generic capacitance maximum.
native.i2c_pin_cap_pf: Actual pin capacitance. Ordinary qualified device max10pF; switches/multiplexers can exceed with explicit device evidence.
native.i2c_special_pin: Actual special switch/multiplexer exception, unknown; prevents falsely applying ordinary10pF limit.
native.i2c_extended_frequency_bound_bps: Actual verified section7.2 load/drive/RC/segmentation frequency bound, never an automatic higher mode or unspecified relaxation.
native.i2c_extended_source: Actual section7.2 calculations/datasheet/buffer and rise/fall/voltage evidence for non-baseline electrical load.
native.i2c_bus_clear: Actual recovery policy. Nine clocks are for SDA-stuck; SCL-stuck may require reset/power-cycle, not automatic nine-clock repair.
native.i2c_recovery_source: Actual stuck-line/retry/recovery/acceptance limits and controller capability; recovery is extra schedule time.
native.i2c_retry_limit: Actual transaction retry budget, no universal zero or guaranteed arbitration completion.
native.i2c_low_ns: Actual low timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_high_ns: Actual high timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_start_hold_ns: Actual start_hold timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_start_setup_ns: Actual start_setup timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_stop_setup_ns: Actual stop_setup timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_bus_free_ns: Actual bus_free timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_data_setup_ns: Actual data_setup timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_data_hold_ns: Actual data_hold timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_rise_ns: Actual rise timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_fall_ns: Actual fall timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_data_valid_ns: Actual data_valid timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_ack_valid_ns: Actual ack_valid timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_hs_first_rise_ns: Actual hs_first_rise timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_hs_data_rise_ns: Actual hs_data_rise timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.i2c_hs_data_fall_ns: Actual hs_data_fall timing at actual load/threshold/mode. Normative mode limits are constraints, not measured default values.
native.local_timing_evidence.evidence_scope: Actual controller port, target port or complete transaction; legacy omitted scope remains transaction only.
native.local_timing_evidence.master_node_id: Actual owning controller canonical identity. Not a target address.
native.local_timing_evidence.slave_address: Actual unshifted target integer or decimal/0x hexadecimal text, not the controller own port address.
native.local_timing_evidence.i2c_mode: Actual standard/fast/fastplus/HS/UFm mode, no confirmation by baseline proposal.
native.local_timing_evidence.start_stop_bound_u: Actual sum of START/repeatedSTART/STOP/bus-free timing for the transfer layout; no universal2us.
native.local_timing_evidence.clock_stretch_limi: Actual total target/controller stretch bound. I2C has no universal timeout; UFm requires zero.
native.local_timing_evidence.transfer_bits_boun: Actual total data-phase clock bound including all address/data9th pulses/register overhead; HS entry separately bounded.
native.local_timing_evidence.multi_master: Actual competing controllers; not assumed false.
native.local_timing_evidence.arbitration_bound_: Actual complete retry/competition upper bound only for multicontroller transactions; no automatic zero.
native.local_timing_evidence.bitrate_bps: Actual data-phase bus clock, positive during active transfers; stopped0Hz is not a positive capacity rate.
native.local_timing_evidence.hs_entry_rate_bps: Actual HS entry F/S clock1..400k; optional outsideHS.
native.local_timing_evidence.hs_entry_bound_us: Actual HS entry duration incl9-bit controller-code/NACK phase; not serialized at HS rate.
native.local_timing_evidence.bus_cap_pf: Actual HS line load needed for HS timing qualification, unknown.
native.local_timing_evidence.hs_clock_timing_so: Actual load-interpolated HS LOW/HIGH/edge timing and current-source proof.
native.local_timing_evidence.address_purpose: Actual reserved7-bit service purpose; absent legacy nonreserved target remains ordinary only.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application/encoded data octets, no255-byte I2C maximum or8-byte default. Complete transaction includes all address/register/ninth-clock/repeatedSTART and optionalHS-entry phases.
native.bitrate: Actual mode-specific active I2C clock; 100000 bit/s Standard is a literature proposal, not a minimum clock or confirmed transaction/capacity. Sm/Fm/Fm+/HS/UFm have separate rate and physical constraints.

scope: Each I2C form and local device field reviewed independently. Five operating categories and load-dependentHS timing. Port roles differ from target addressing and complete transaction proof.100k Standard is a review proposal, not capacity evidence. No CAN/SMBus/Ethernet fallback.

validation.suite: full_parameter_audit + standard_defaults + profile_semantics + capacity_can_schedule + parameter_review + required_parameters + physical_profiles + serial_parameter_validity + unverified_technology_capacity + communication_dimensioning

not_certified: Actual datasheets/pins/voltage/load/pullup/unique addresses, HS mixed-mode/load timing, reserved services and switch/buffer topology require installation evidence
Local bound validation sizes declared transaction clocks and HS entry only; not a byte-level ACK/address/arbitration/recovery state-machine simulator or electrical proof
Complete device/register/combined layouts, actual retry/stretch/competing-controller schedules, correlated E2E timing and safety acceptance are not inferred from default frequency
